title: Nonlinear kinetic Fokker-Planck equations as gradient flows of the free energy
summary: We consider nonhomogeneous kinetic equations that involve a free transport operator and a diffusion of porous medium type acting on velocities. The main novelty is a gradient flow interpretation of dynamics driven by an interplay of conservative and dissipative effects. We rely on a notion of discrepancy adapted to a phase space of positions and velocities, built upon second-order characteristics obeying Newton's laws.
